name: tpl-responded-existence-1-nogoal
task: If you pick up the key, you must also open the door.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task's only requirement is the conditional 'if you pick up the key, you must also open the door', with no timing cue, so a single hard RespondedExistence(has_door_key, door_open) captures it exactly. has_door_key is only the condition of an 'if' and is never commanded, so no Existence clause is needed; the rule-only warning with an empty FINAL_STATES is valid here.

texts: If the agent picks up the matching key, it must also open the door at some point.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1, u2
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key) -> u1
(u0, door_open) -> u2
(u1, door_open) -> u2
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, !door_open&has_door_key, u1) -> -1
(u1, door_open, u2) -> 1
